facts.C_word_stride: row*62 uint16_t units = row*124 bytes; explicit int16_t cost consumption
row*62 uint16_t units = row*124 bytes; BYTE+2 and WORD+48 fields stay distinct.

meaning: Declaration/address units and actual operand widths are separate. Direct scalar/word views match their native operand widths. Byte-address bases deliberately use unit1 with existing explicit DWORD accesses; source use lines, address producers and native/C record cases qualify their mapping. This is not full-function proof.
